capture_source.label: Capture Device
capture_source.description: PipeWire source node name to feed into RNNoise. Leave as auto to use the panel's device picker or the physical-input match.

poll_interval_ms.label: Status Refresh Interval
poll_interval_ms.description: How often microphone mute, volume, and available capture devices are refreshed, in milliseconds.

scroll_step.label: Scroll Volume Step
scroll_step.description: Percentage points to change the processed microphone volume for each bar scroll step.
